verdict.rationale: The SOS Corporations & Charities hub lists task-oriented guidance pages such as "Start a Domestic (WA) Business," "Register a Foreign (Non-WA) LLC Online," "Close a Corporation Online" and "How to Obtain an Apostille." These suggest how-to explainers rather than only statute text and form numbers, but the evidence is page titles only, with no captured content showing plain-language, step-by-step instructions. The DOR Business Licensing Wizard belongs to a different agency, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: actual page content showing step-by-step, non-lawyer-readable instructions; coverage depth across founder tasks; any independent or hands-on corroboration that the guides are followable.
